https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10017963

Mega Man is overriding his limits and powering up for a new adventure, but this time, he's not alone! Proto Man joins the Blue Bomber as they take on new dangers in the latest addition to the Mega Man series. 

Robots are running rampant at the Robot exhibition in Dr. Light's absence, and it's up to Mega Man and Proto Man to rise to the challenge to restore peace to the city. Override your limits and uncover the truth behind the incident!

Get equipped with new Custom Chips to freely modify and enhance your abilities and unleash overwhelming power for a limited time with the new Override system! Use these abilities to take on formidable foes across expansive stages including the newly revealed Robot Master, Twinkle Girl!

Mega Man: Dual Override launches in 2027 for PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4.

text:
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - 6th Trailer: The Challenges That Await | PS5 Games
Pre-order now: https://www.playstation.com/games/onimusha-way-of-the-sword/


The latest trailer for Capcom's all new swordplay action game, Onimusha: Way of the Sword, has been unveiled!
The 6th trailer introduces us to the Genma siblings Ifuu and Burai, and showcases the battles that await against some of the previously revealed bosses.
You'll also finally get a glimpse of what Musashi's capable of in his Oni Awakening form, so be sure to check it out!

Demo available now!
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP0102-PPSA27836_00-DEMO000000000002

- Footage represents a game still in development.
- Some footage was captured with enemy dismemberment death effects disabled.

Onimusha: Way of the Sword, an all-new entry in the Onimusha series, plunges the Oni Gauntlet wielding protagonist, Miyamoto Musashi into an early Edo-period Kyoto under siege by monstrous fiends known as Genma. Feel the ring of steel on steel as blades clash in tense back-and-forth duels. Cut down foes with authentic and satisfying swordplay. Awaken Oni Powers to pull off superhuman feats. All these elements combine to deliver an unprecedented swordplay action experience you will not want to miss.
